title: Group changelog 0.6.0 by user-facing topics
description: Reorganize 0.6.0 beta changelog entries into grouped sections highlighting what matters for users: settings, UI, performance/startup, and fixes.

title: UI tweak: альтернативный light-стиль таблиц
description: Сделать светлую тему таблиц менее синей и более нейтральной, сохранив тёмную тему без изменений.

title: Add ui-kit Spin and DatePicker; migrate statistics and loaders
description: Introduce ui-kit wrappers for Spin and DatePicker and replace direct Antd control imports in pages/components where these controls are used (Statistics and related loaders).

title: UI fix: приглушить светлый header таблицы
description: В светлой теме header таблицы выглядит слишком белым. Сделать фон хедера более нейтрально-голубым в рамках текущей дизайн-системы.

title: Tokenize button styles in ui-kit
description: Move hardcoded button gradients/shadows/disabled/danger styles into theme palette tokens and unify ButtonPrimary, ButtonTextPrimary, and link button visual states.

title: Polish page headers for content creation screens
description: Unify visual style and hierarchy of top page headers/breadcrumb bars on pages where user creates/edits content (Add Node/Add Validator and related forms). Keep dark/light theme parity and reuse ui-kit styles.

title: Refactor: семантические цвета для menu и table
description: Вынести цвета меню (active/hover/icon/accent) и таблиц (header/border/hover) в централизованные семантические токены темы и использовать их в styled/antd.

title: Redesign global ghost button style
description: Tune global ghost button typography and contrast in light/dark themes via palette tokens to match app visual language (closer to subtle segmented controls).

title: Theme-consistent styling for mnemonic word chips
description: Restyle selectable mnemonic word chips in VerifyMnemonic to match app theme language with semantic palette tokens for normal/hover/active/disabled states.

title: Cap maximum chunk size for mass actions
description: Add upper bound for mass action chunk size so very large validator sets do not send overly large batches while keeping smooth progress updates.

title: Migrate remaining antd types and grid primitives in renderer
description: Eliminate remaining direct antd imports in renderer feature code: TableColumnsType, StepsProps, Col/Row via ui-kit exports/wrappers.

title: Visual consistency pass for add/import/mnemonic flows
description: Unify visual states (default/hover/active/disabled/error) across Add Node, Add Worker, Import Worker, and Mnemonic flows using ui-kit tokens and shared components.

title: UI: улучшить визуал меню в сайдбаре
description: Сделать меню в сайдбаре визуально богаче: выразительные active/hover/focus состояния, отступы, типографика и аккуратные эффекты в light/dark темах.

title: Refine startup caption to avoid duplicated step counters
description: Adjust update window caption formatting so done state does not show redundant current step text.

title: UI fix: убрать вертикальный бордер и починить скругление таблицы
description: Убрать разделительную вертикальную линию между sidebar и content и исправить нарушение скругления внизу таблиц.

title: Make mnemonic chips smaller and theme-radio-like
description: Adjust VerifyMnemonic word chips to be smaller and visually aligned with Settings theme radio-button style (pill borders, subtle background, compact typography).

title: UI: унификация форм, Tabs и Modal
description: Привести Input/Select/Radio/Switch/Tabs/Modal к единому light/dark стилю в liquid-glass концепции через токены и ui-kit.

title: Close app when frameless update window is closed
description: Add close shortcuts for frameless update window and quit app when update window closes before main window appears.

title: Add consistent micro-animations for table row action icon buttons
description: Apply subtle hover/press icon-button motion for row action buttons in workers/nodes tables with reduced-motion fallback and theme-driven colors.

title: UI: вернуть цветовые префиксы и убрать issueId из changelog
description: Вернуть разные цвета для New/Improve/Update/Fix и удалить issueId из модели, данных и вывода changelog.

title: Add smooth tabs transitions for active pages
description: Introduce subtle animated tab content transitions and active tab motion using theme-safe styles and reduced-motion fallback.

title: Add section stagger animations for tab content and bulk modals
description: Introduce subtle staggered reveal for content sections inside tab panels and bulk operation modals, with reduced-motion fallback.

title: Centralize PageBody underlap spacing constants
description: Move PageBody scroll-under-header overlap and padding values into layout constants to avoid magic numbers and simplify future tuning.

title: Add sidebar/button/route motion polish
description: Implement next animation pass: sidebar active/hover motion, richer button micro-interactions, and subtle route content crossfade with reduced-motion support.

title: Improve mass action modals UI and English copy
description: Refresh visual design of mass operation modals and improve English wording for titles, descriptions, and button labels while keeping behavior intact and theme-driven.

title: Apply global IconButton micro-motion via ui-kit and remove local overrides
description: Implement safe global hover/press animation for IconButton in ui-kit and remove per-page/table duplicates.

title: Make done-state spinner fully colored
description: In startup done state, render spinner as a full colored ring instead of partial segment.

title: Temporarily keep update window only on startup
description: Disable main window auto-open and keep update window visible for UI review.

title: Add ui-kit wrappers for overlay/special Antd components
description: Introduce ui-kit wrappers for Popover, Tooltip, Empty, QRCode, Timeline and migrate feature code to them to reduce direct Antd imports.

title: Use unified ghost style for Back button in wizards
description: Remove local muted Back button overrides in Add Node/Add Validator forms and use the same global ghost style as Settings theme buttons.

title: Tune Back button text color in light/dark themes
description: Back ghost button text color is too saturated. Introduce semantic token(s) and use muted, theme-specific text colors for ghost buttons.

title: Add smooth step-content transitions for Add Node and Add Validator
description: Animate step content changes in wizard forms to reduce abrupt switches between steps, with reduced-motion support.

title: Add subtle live-update pulse for changing table values
description: Highlight updated status/reward values with a short theme-aware pulse animation when data changes.

title: Migrate update page to React
description: Implement update startup page as React component (TSX) instead of direct DOM script.

title: UI tweak: снизить акцент префиксов в changelog
description: Сделать New/Improve/Update/Fix менее кричащими: более нейтральный цвет и меньший визуальный вес.

title: UI: проработать иконки меню
description: Добавить выразительные иконки в меню с отдельным active-состоянием (outline/filled) и улучшенной стилизацией контейнера иконок для light/dark тем.

title: Move hardcoded UI colors to palette tokens and route form controls through ui-kit
description: Replace component-level theme.mode color branching with semantic palette tokens for page header/card/form actions, and migrate Add Worker form controls from direct Antd imports to ui-kit wrappers.

title: UI: Apple liquid glass sidebar + версия в сайдбаре
description: Переделать боковое меню в liquid-glass стиле, скрыть футер и показать версию приложения внизу сайдбара.

title: Align startup loader colors with logo palette
description: Use logo.svg brand colors for startup spinner and progress bar visuals.

title: UI: унификация таблиц и карточек
description: Привести таблицы и карточные контейнеры к единому визуальному стилю (radius/border/header/hover/shadow) через ui-kit и тему.

title: Add stagger reveal for page header action buttons
description: Animate page header actions with subtle staggered reveal for import/add and similar button groups across active pages.

title: UI fix: breadcrumb типографика и light-цвет заголовка
description: Исправить визуальные проблемы breadcrumb в page header и убрать слишком черный тон текста в светлой теме.

title: UI: базовая дизайн-система light/dark на Ant Design
description: Внедрить токены темы (light/dark), подключить через ConfigProvider, обновить базовые компоненты и фон приложения в стиле splash-экрана.

title: UI: привести action-кнопки страниц к новому стилю
description: Обновить визуал кнопок на страницах Nodes/Workers (включая Add и Import Validator), чтобы соответствовали новой light/dark дизайн-системе.

title: Refactor update page into separate HTML/CSS/TS files
description: Move inline update.html styles and script into src/renderer/update/styles.css and src/renderer/update/main.ts.

title: Fix false incompatibility for bulk withdraw with active validators
description: Investigate and fix  shown for bulk withdraw when selected active validators should be compatible but may have multiple withdraw rules.

title: Unify ui-kit import entry points
description: Add missing ui-kit index exports and migrate imports to package-level entry points (e.g. Steps) to avoid deep-path usage where unnecessary.

title: Force active step number color in light theme
description: Active (process) step number remains white in light theme due Antd specificity. Override with stronger selectors for active/process icon and nested icon text.

title: Polish update progress window UI
description: Make startup update window visually polished and compact instead of plain text message.

title: Style update window title bar like main window
description: Replace default OS title bar on update window with hidden/overlay style to remove visible title text.

title: Restore system window controls for update window
description: Switch update window from frameless mode back to native window controls while keeping custom look.

title: Fix AntD warnings and add table row reveal animation
description: Resolve Space/Button deprecation warnings and add subtle row stagger animation in shared Table UI kit component.

title: Refine page header liquid glass layering
description: Enhance PageHeader glass with additional tokenized sheen/glow layer for clearer translucent depth in light and dark themes.

title: Make done-state progress bar green
description: In startup done state, color progress bar with the same green as the done spinner.

title: Use app logo on startup update window
description: Integrate existing renderer public logo.svg into update startup window branding.

title: Add micro-interactions for mass action icon buttons
description: Add subtle hover and press motion for bulk action icon buttons in workers toolbar with reduced-motion fallback.

title: Add global modal open/close motion polish
description: Implement shared modal entrance/exit animation in ui-kit Modal so all dialogs have consistent subtle motion with reduced-motion support.

title: Update changelog with theme and bulk operation improvements
description: Add new top changelog release entry summarizing visual theme refresh, layout polish, and bulk operations UX/logic improvements.

title: Refactor: семантические цвета UI в theme palette
description: Вынести локальные хардкоды цветов в семантические токены темы и использовать их в changelog/page header/breadcrumb.

title: Unify micro-motion for ArrowedButton and text buttons
description: Apply subtle hover/press transitions to ArrowedButton and text button variants to match global interaction rhythm.

title: Make mass action progress update near 1% steps
description: Adjust mass action chunk size to target roughly 1% progress increments instead of large jumps.

title: UI tweak: синхронизировать цвета light таблиц с меню
description: Использовать цветовые акценты светлого liquid-меню в таблицах (header/border/hover), чтобы интерфейс был визуально цельным.

title: Improve signer info readability in bulk action modal
description: Make private key and signer details section in bulk modal clearer: structured labels, readable address list, and styled signer card for address/balance.

title: Make page body scroll under header shell
description: Adjust PageHeader/PageBody layering so scrolling content visually goes under bordered page header shell instead of stopping before it.

title: Add PageBody enter animation
description: Introduce subtle one-time page content reveal animation on mount with reduced-motion fallback and no polling flicker.

title: Epic: Settings page and runtime configuration
description: Реализовать полноценный модуль настроек приложения: хранение в БД, управление через UI и применение в рантайме. В scope: тема Light/Dark/System, запуск, мониторинг, импорт/экспорт конфигурации. Out of scope: директория данных по умолчанию и кастомные RPC из UI (RPC пока задаются в коде).

title: Settings: DB migration and settings model
description: Создать таблицу settings и модель доступа к настройкам в main-процессе. Обеспечить хранение единственной записи настроек и безопасное частичное обновление полей.
close_reason: Completed: added settings table migration, settings model with validated partial updates, registered migration, and updated data model docs

title: Settings UX: progress modal for import/export with counts
description: При import/export в Settings показывать модалку прогресса. После завершения выводить количество экспортированных/импортированных nodes и workers (validators).
close_reason: Implemented import/export progress modal with completion counts and updated import IPC contract docs

title: Settings: IPC contracts and renderer bridge
description: Добавить IPC-хендлеры settings:* и preload bridge, а также renderer-типы/API/hooks для чтения и обновления настроек.
close_reason: Completed: added settings IPC module, startup wiring, preload bridge, renderer settings types/api/hooks, and IPC/security docs updates

title: Monitoring settings: configurable polling interval
description: Сделать интервал мониторинга настраиваемым через Settings и применяемым в StatusMonitoring без перезапуска приложения.
close_reason: Completed: status monitoring now reads interval from settings on init and applies SettingsUpdated interval changes at runtime without restart

title: Theme: Light/Dark/System support
description: Реализовать применение темы приложения через настройки: Light, Dark, System. Для System использовать тему ОС.
close_reason: Completed: App now applies Light/Dark/System settings via Ant Design ConfigProvider and reacts to OS color scheme changes for System mode

title: Settings UI: replace placeholder with settings form
description: Заменить заглушку страницы Settings на рабочий UI для управления поддерживаемыми настройками эпика (без storage и network-секции).
close_reason: Completed: implemented Settings page UI with theme/startup/monitoring sections, save flow, and config export/import actions

title: Config backup: export/import with validation
description: Добавить экспорт и импорт конфигурации (settings + nodes) в JSON с обязательной валидацией при импорте.
close_reason: Completed: added strict import payload validation for config backup (version, timestamp, settings fields, node/worker structure) and apply imported settings only on valid payload

title: Startup settings: app auto-start and nodes auto-start
description: Реализовать настройки автозапуска приложения и автоматического старта нод при запуске приложения.
close_reason: Completed: app login autostart is synchronized from settings on startup; node autostart at app launch now respects settings.autoStartNodes

title: Settings: factory reset action with confirmation
description: Добавить на страницу Settings опасное действие 'Reset to factory defaults' с подтверждением. Действие должно очищать БД пользовательских данных (nodes/workers) и возвращать settings к дефолтным значениям, с валидацией безопасного выполнения.
close_reason: Completed: added factory reset action with confirmation; implemented settings:resetFactory IPC to clear nodes/workers and restore defaults with running-nodes safety check

title: Settings import: restore nodes and workers from backup
description: Импорт backup сейчас применяет только settings. Нужно восстанавливать также nodes и workers из JSON (с транзакцией и валидацией), чтобы импорт действительно поднимал конфигурацию нод/валидаторов.
close_reason: Completed: import now restores nodes/workers records from backup in transaction and invalidates node/worker queries so UI reflects imported data

title: Final animation polish pass
description: Soften motion intensity, reduce over-animation on table-heavy areas, and harmonize timing across shell and ui-kit.

title: Add action toolbar reveal and row update highlight
description: Animate actions toolbar appearance and highlight updated worker rows after polling/action refresh on active pages.

title: Enable full-window drag zone for update window
description: Make the whole update window content draggable while keeping native system window controls.

title: Remove tab top border artifact in statistics tabs
description: Extra horizontal line was rendered in Node/Worker Statistics tabs due to nested Ant Layout receiving global box-shadow styles. Remove nested Layout wrappers so content renders cleanly.

title: Add transitions for Empty/Alert and unify Popover/Tooltip timing
description: Implement subtle reveal animations for Empty and Alert states and align Popover/Tooltip show/hide timing globally.

title: Add live-update pulse to stats totals
description: Apply LiveValue animation to key aggregate metrics on statistics pages where values update from polling.

title: Adjust tabs active shape to match ink bar
description: Remove bottom corner rounding from tabs so active pill visually aligns with bottom indicator line.

title: Scope muted back-button style only to wizard forms
description: Keep global ghost button color used in Settings, and apply muted Back button text only in Add Node/Add Validator step forms.

title: Migrate antd primitives (Flex/Layout/Space/Divider) to ui-kit
description: Add ui-kit wrappers for Flex/Layout/Space/Divider and migrate renderer feature/pages/containers/components imports away from direct antd usage.

title: Add reveal animation for timeline items
description: Animate timeline items appearance for changelog and any timeline-based views with reduced-motion support.

title: Fix step number contrast in light theme
description: Active step number in light theme is low contrast/invisible. Add explicit step number color tokens and apply in ui-kit Steps styles.

title: Оптимизация рендера страницы валидаторов при большом списке
description: Есть подлагивание при переходе на страницу валидаторов, вероятно из-за рендера большого количества элементов. Нужно найти узкое место и оптимизировать производительность рендера.

title: UI: полиш типографики changelog
description: Сделать changelog более сканируемым: версия заметнее даты, улучшить ритм между релизами, слегка подсветить префиксы New/Improve/Fix и ограничить ширину текста.

title: Add animation improvements entry to changelog
description: Add release note item about new UI animations and motion polish in current version.

title: Temporarily slow startup steps and keep update window open
description: Add artificial delay between startup steps for progress demo and do not open main window after startup completes.

title: UI: polish страницы Add Node
description: Привести страницу Add Node к новому визуальному уровню: шаги, секции формы, preview, ритм отступов, контрастность и состояние ошибок в light/dark.

title: Remove action divider from all wizard steps
description: Drop top border line above action buttons in all Add Node/Add Validator step forms.

title: Remove actions divider on preview forms
description: Hide top divider line above action buttons specifically on preview steps for add node/add validator flows.

title: Add global modal motion in ui-kit
description: Implement unified modal panel and mask animations with reduced-motion fallback in ui-kit Modal so all dialogs get consistent transitions.

title: Enhance page header with liquid glass effect
description: Improve PageHeader shell to a stronger liquid glass look with translucent blur layer while keeping theme tokens for colors/borders/shadows.

title: Add subtle page and tab animations
description: Implement lightweight motion for page headers and tab content transitions with reduced-motion support.

title: Make bulk modal progress full-width and highlighted
description: Expand progress bar to full modal width and present execution progress as a dedicated status block with clear counters.

title: Startup progress with step count and error reporting
description: Show startup initialization progress in update window with completed/total steps, current step details, and visible error state when a step fails.

title: Remove transient row highlight grid effect in tables
description: Drop temporary wf-row-updated highlight that creates perceived grid flash during polling updates.

title: beads sync health check
description: Temporary issue to verify JSONL export path

title: Unify Settings controls through ui-kit
description: Replace direct Antd control usage in Settings cards with ui-kit base components and align spacing/typography for consistent theme styling.

title: Audit and unify button motion across app
description: Review all button usages and ensure consistent ui-kit hover/press animation, including Add action on Nodes page.

title: Re-enable main window open after startup completes
description: After successful startup sequence, open main app window instead of staying on update screen preview mode.

title: Consolidate changelog updates into current release
description: Remove separate 0.6.1 entry and merge recent UI/bulk improvements into concise grouped items under current release.

title: Finalize visual acceptance checklist for light/dark themes
description: Audit current UI implementation against visual checklist (contrast, states, artifacts, spacing/radius) and record status in spec/07-visual-refresh-and-ui-kit.md with remaining gaps.

title: Fix Add Node port availability validation
description: Port check on Add Node no longer surfaces occupied ports as warnings. Investigate checkPorts mapping and status handling in Add Node flow and restore proper validation feedback.

title: Refactor main process into windows/startup/tray modules
description: Apply modular split of main index.ts into startup, windows, and app shell/tray modules while preserving runtime behavior.

title: Tie changelog updates to package.json version
description: Document that changelog entries must be added under the release matching package.json version before commit.

title: Add TabContent variants for text and table layouts
description: Implement TabContent variant API in ui-kit/Tabs and migrate node/worker tab screens to use variant=text for textual views and variant=table for full-width table views.

title: Migrate remaining direct Antd controls in feature screens
description: Find and replace direct Antd control imports in renderer feature components (outside ui-kit) with ui-kit wrappers where available; keep layout helpers only where needed.

title: Add stagger reveal animation for bulk modal sections
description: Animate bulk modal blocks with subtle staggered reveal while respecting prefers-reduced-motion.

title: Replace executeJavaScript startup updates with IPC events
description: Send startup status to update window via webContents.send + preload subscription API instead of executeJavaScript.

title: UI: редизайн заголовков страниц
description: Улучшить общий PageHeader: типографика, подложка, выравнивание, breadcrumb и actions для light/dark тем.

title: Использовать monitoringInterval из настроек для refetch в рендере
description: Привязать частоту UI-запросов (списки валидаторов, статистика, страница ноды) к settings.monitoringInterval вместо захардкоженных интервалов.

title: Unify Back/Next button visual states in step forms
description: Back/Next buttons in Add Node flow change style inconsistently because ghost toggles with disabled state. Make button variants stable across states.

title: UI fix: hover-контур пункта меню
description: Исправить визуальный артефакт: нижняя граница пункта меню на hover выглядит недорисованной.

title: Глобально применить оптимизации polling и таблиц
description: Применить monitoringInterval из настроек ко всем страницам с refetchInterval и снизить стоимость рендера таблиц на уровне ui-kit/Table для всех таблиц.

title: Refactor: перенести прямые анtd-кнопки в ui-kit
description: Заменить прямые импорты Button из antd на ui-kit/Button в renderer, чтобы базовые кнопки проходили через единый дизайн-слой.

title: Make update window frameless with full drag zone
description: Use frameless update window and enable draggable region across full update UI.

title: Add live pulse for total metrics in table headers
description: Animate Total values in table headers (e.g., Rewards total) when backend refresh updates them.

title: Remove artificial startup step delay
description: Disable temporary delay between startup steps so initialization runs at normal speed.

title: Eliminate remaining theme.mode style branching
description: Find all remaining theme.mode==='dark' styling branches in renderer and replace with semantic palette tokens.

title: Audit docs for UI redesign and motion updates
description: Review docs for consistency with implemented theming, ui-kit adoption, and animation behavior; patch any outdated sections.

title: UI tweak: приглушить цвет префикса Fix в changelog
description: Снизить акцент только у префикса Fix в changelog, не меняя цвета остальных префиксов.

title: Add minimal startup step delay for visibility
description: Introduce a small delay between startup steps so progress updates are visible without significantly slowing startup.

title: Remove version badge focus artifact in sidebar
description: Disable all default focus/active visual outlines for clickable version badge link in sidebar to eliminate cyan arc artifact.

title: Simplify startup caption to current step only
description: Show only current step index (X/Y) during startup and concise error caption without completed counters.

title: Set minimum content height for loading states
description: Ensure loading placeholders keep a stable minimum height so background/cards do not collapse to spinner height when content is empty.

title: Polish Coming Soon pages visuals and copy
description: Improve under-development page styling and replace placeholder copy with clear, grammatically correct text. Align ComingSoon page layout with PageBody.

title: Fix Antd Steps wait number visibility in light theme
description: Previous number-color selector did not fully match Antd Steps DOM. Apply state-specific selectors for wait/process/finish with explicit opacity and colors.

title: Add consistent text-content padding in all view tabs
description: Apply consistent horizontal padding for text-based tab content across node/worker view tabs while keeping table tabs full-width.

title: Require changelog update before commit
description: Add project rule and docs requirement: before commit, update changelog with short bullets describing completed work.
